0.original: Qhoterl Pasol knows that a gift or three never goes astray.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Deliver the jadeite adornments to the denizens of Fanow.

48.original: During one of our recent outings, we came upon some lovely jadeite adornments. The stones each bear an etching of a Viis, which marks them as relics of the Ronkan Empire.

49.original: As a gesture of friendship, I've a mind to present them to the good folk of Fanow, but I believe that the gift would be all the more meaningful coming from you, the ally of Ronka.

50.original: I should be so very grateful were you to deliver these three adornments in my stead, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

51.original: Greetings, ally of Ronka. Is there something you require? ...A gift for me, you say?

52.original: Well now, this is indeed a surprise. In the times of the empire, such jadeite adornments symbolized magical might.

53.original: They were prized items, and I am honored to receive it. Pray pass my regards to our friends of the Qitari.

54.original: Oh, another adornment? I know not what I've done to deserve such kindness, but I'm thankful nonetheless.

55.original: Well met, honored ally. What brings you to Fanow this day?

56.original: ...Hm. Unless I am mistaken, this adornment was crafted in ancient times to commemorate the friendship between our people and the Qitari.

57.original: The whorled pattern enclosing the Viis symbolizes eternity─a prayer for enduring harmony, I shouldn't doubt.

58.original: This is a gift of no less than a piece of history, and I am duly grateful for it. My heartful thanks to our Qitari friends.

59.original: Oh, you wish to give me another one of these? Far be it from me to decline the generosity of our Qitari friends. My thanks.

60.original: Hm? You have something for me, you say?

61.original: My, such a lovely adornment this is. To simply gaze upon it makes me feel closer to our ancestors.

62.original: Please give the Qitari my thanks, and tell them that they may call upon me in times of need.

63.original: Oh, another one of these lovely adornments. Please give the Qitari my thanks, and tell them that they may call upon me in times of need.

64.original: I am honored for the gift. Pray pass my regards to our friends of the Qitari.

65.original: This is a gift of no less than a piece of history. My heartful thanks to our Qitari friends.

66.original: Please give the Qitari my thanks, and tell them that they may call upon me in times of need.

67.original: Ah, welcome back, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. May I ask how the adornments were received?

68.original: ...Splendid, splendid. Should we chance to unearth more, I will be certain to make gifts of them again.
